newsitem.title: DUBAI: British warship in Gulf saves sinking dhow's crew.
newsitem.headline: British warship in Gulf saves sinking dhow's crew.

text.p: A British warship on patrol in the Gulf rescued the crew of a United Arab Emirates-registered dhow after the traditional trade vessel began sinking, the British Embassy in Dubai said on Sunday.

The Al Mansoor 3, carrying rice and sugar on a regular supply run, sent out a mayday on Friday night when its pumps failed in the central Gulf and it began taking on water, the embassy said in a statement.
The boat's crew, all Pakistani nationals, were winched on board the destroyer Edinburgh as the dhow sank.
The Edinburgh and a number of other ships from several countries enforce United Nations sanctions on Iraq.
